# Website Health Check: Hua Kang Health Center

**What we saw on 13 November 2026**

- huakangskincare.com, the shop's own site since 2014, now opens a GoDaddy parking page (huakangskincare.com/lander) reading "parked free, courtesy of GoDaddy.com", with a "Get This Domain" button and unrelated skin-care ad links.
- Google's profile for Hua Kang Health Center (118 Ryders Ln, Milltown NJ 08850; 732-253-7885; 4.4 stars; "Massage therapist"; closes 9 PM) lists no website at all - Google shows an "Add website" prompt.
- Archives show the old site's facials, skin care and hot-stone massage pages; the last working capture is February 2023, and by April 2024 the address served the parking page.
- Two older domains linked from that site are also unusable: huakanghealthcenter.com does not resolve; huakangspa.com returns a Cloudflare 522 error.

**What it means for customers**

Anyone finding the shop on Google gets hours and a phone number, but nothing about treatments or prices. Anyone typing the old address or following an old link lands on a page offering the domain for sale.

**How to fix it**

1. Check the GoDaddy account holding huakangskincare.com (renewal due 27 March 2027) and who controls it - owner or office manager, 1-2 hours.
2. If it is yours, attach a one-page site (services, hours, prices, tap-to-call) to it - web helper, 4-8 hours.
3. If it is not yours, register a new domain, publish the page there and stop printing the old address - owner plus helper, 3-6 hours.
4. Add the new address to the Google profile and correct directory listings showing the old domain - 1-2 hours.
5. Turn on auto-renew and check the domain once a year - half an hour.

**After the fix**

Add a tap-to-call button and a short request form to the new page and link it from Google; the shop opens seven days, 10am-9pm, with no online booking today.

Prepared from publicly available information on 13 November 2026. We did not log in to or change anything.
